unit.title: Concurrency Contracts and a Mutex-Protected FIFO Cache
unit.audience: A strong algorithms student with basic Rust and concurrency knowledge who is developing production-oriented software-engineering habits
unit.scope: Specify, implement, test, and document one small bounded concurrent Rust component using safe standard-library synchronization.
learning_objectives: Translate a sequential data-structure specification into explicit concurrent safety and API contracts.
Identify linearization points for operations protected by a mutex.
Implement a bounded FIFO cache in safe Rust without exposing synchronization guards.
Write deterministic sequential and schedule-independent concurrent tests without timing sleeps.
Record reproducible build evidence and distinguish unit evidence from whole-course completion.
out_of_scope: Completion of any linked CS431 assignment

unit_completion_requires: All required learner deliverables are present.
An independent validator runs formatting, lint, build, and test checks in a controlled environment.
The implementation and written work meet the examiner-only rubric threshold and critical-category floors.
Validation evidence is attached to the attempt rather than inferred from learner or agent prose.
completion_policy.course_completion_requirement: A later course-management job must retrieve and classify authorized source materials, define the remaining official or manager-authored units, and validate each required unit independently.

unit_derivation.basis: The supplied catalog description, declared prerequisite, language, and topic range
